_comment: The user-account rules as data (WORKORDER-userSqlAndSaveHole-111026). Read by lib/user-profile-rules.js, which refuses at load if any entry is missing. selfEditablePropertyList is what POST /api/saveUserData lets a signed-in user change on their OWN record; anything else in the body is refused by name, never dropped. html/stores/loginStore.js SELF_EDITABLE_PROPERTY_LIST must equal it (gate B1 of server/test/user-sql-and-save-hole.test.js).
_selfEditablePropertyList: the profile page's own fields (components/form_profile.vue). username, role and refId are never self-editable: role and username change only through the admin tools, and the record is always the signed-in user's own.
_ownRecordPropertyName: the one property outside the list a body may carry: the record's own identifier, accepted only when it equals the signed-in user's refId (the write is keyed on the token's refId either way).
_currentPasswordPropertyName: the property that must accompany a new password: the CURRENT password, verified against the stored hash before the new one is hashed and saved, so a stolen session cannot change the password (ROMANTIC_PARASOL ruling 2026-11-10). Never saved; refused in a body that carries no new password.
_passwordPropertyName: the users table's password property (profile-user maps it under the same name). It must be in selfEditablePropertyList; a non-blank value there is a NEW password.
_adminEditablePropertyList: what admin-create-user and admin-update-user accept (the admin user form sends exactly these; the rater tool sends a subset); anything else is refused by name (propertyNotAdminEditable), never dropped (re-verification 2026-11-10).
_maxLengthByPropertyName: the longest value each self-editable property may hold, refused by name above it (propertyTooLong) BEFORE any save (review SF-7: a 100000-character first name was saved, and every later reply re-signed it into the authtoken header until Node refused the header, locking the account). Every self-editable property must have an entry. password matches validatePasswordStrength's own ceiling.
_emailPatternText: the email rule for the self-save path, the same pattern admin-create-user and admin-update-user apply (review N-2).
_usernamePatternText: the username rule for admin-create-user and admin-update-user, as it stood in both before it moved here (2026-11-10). Production held no username outside it that day.
_refusalByCase: every refusal this module makes: refusalName is the stable name a caller tests, reason is what a person reads, httpStatus is what the endpoint answers. <!detailListText!> is filled with the property names refused, or the password rule's complaints.

noSignedInUser.reason: the sign-in names no user record to save to

bodyNotAnObject.reason: a profile save must send a JSON object of the properties to change

notOwnRecord.reason: a profile save may change only the signed-in user's own record

propertyNotSelfEditable.reason: these cannot be changed from the profile page: <!detailListText!>

usernameNotAllowed.reason: a username may contain only letters, numbers, underscore and hyphen

identifierNotText.reason: a user lookup was given an identifier that is not text: <!detailListText!>

passwordNotAccepted.reason: the new password was not accepted: <!detailListText!>

propertyNotAdminEditable.reason: these cannot be set by the admin user tools: <!detailListText!>

emailAdrNotValid.reason: the email address is not in a valid form

sessionRevoked.reason: this sign-in ended when the account's password was changed; please sign in again

noSuchUser.reason: no user record has that refId

currentPasswordRequired.reason: a new password is saved only with the current password

currentPasswordWrong.reason: the current password given is not this account's password
